name: Julieta Kirkwood
shortBio: Chilean feminist political theorist and sociologist who catalyzed Latin American feminist democratic thought under dictatorship with the maxim "Democracy in the country and in the home."
centralQuestion: Why does political democratization fail if authoritarian patriarchal power remains untouched inside the private household?

keyWorks.title: Ser política en Chile: las feministas y los partidos
keyWorks.description: Analyzes feminist "knots" (nudos) and critiques authoritarianism across both Pinochet’s state and leftist party patriarchy.
